verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS product that ships SDKs, a CLI and an MCP server, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documentation of any setting to disable telemetry, diagnostics or usage tracking in the SDKs, CLI or platform. Community comments only describe evaluation data being sent upstream, and the self-hosted Relay Proxy is an adjacent capability, not an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
